title: Ollama
summary: Local model serving/inference API with optional cloud models; useful as an inference backend, not a creative workbench.
documentation_observations: Official API docs distinguish local server endpoints from cloud API endpoints.
Local host alone does not prove a selected model stays local if a cloud model is chosen.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
